title: Bizagi Launches AI Advisor to Help Enterprises Stop Guessing Where AI Agents Belong
markdown:
[Accessibility Statement](https://www.cision.com/about/accessibility/) [Skip Navigation](https://www.prweb.com/releases/bizagi-launches-ai-advisor-to-help-enterprises-stop-guessing-where-ai-agents-belong-302930665.html#main)

New AI-driven discovery capability shows the business impact first, giving customers a personalized, ranked view of where AI Agents will make the biggest difference and the agentic redesign to get there

WASHINGTON, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ -- Bizagi, the enterprise process orchestration company, today announced Bizagi AI Advisor, an AI-driven discovery tool that produces a personalized, ranked list of where AI can make the biggest difference to a customer's business today. Built into Bizagi Monitoring Center, AI Advisor analyzes how the processes customers run in Bizagi actually perform, identifies the tasks with the greatest potential, and suggests how AI Agents could redesign them.

Choosing where to apply AI has become a bottleneck for many enterprises. Most organizations have a long list of AI ideas, and shortlists are often built from workshops and assumptions. AI Advisor replaces that guesswork with evidence that is specific to each customer.

AI Advisor puts business impact first. A statistical model built on Bizagi's process automation experience finds and scores AI opportunities using real-life execution statistics, such as volume, duration, waiting time and SLA performance. Opportunities are ranked by what they're worth to the business, so teams can prioritize by impact, not instinct. AI then turns the leading opportunities into detailed recommendations, each showing:

- The business outcome, including the estimated time that could be saved
- How the task works today and the suggested agentic redesign, including any human review step
- Detailed implementation guidance covering data, governance, validation and adoption
- The evidence behind the recommendation

AI Advisor uses metadata, not business data. It works from process metadata, such as process structure, forms and rules, together with execution statistics, so no private data is needed and there are no event logs to extract. Its recommendations are suggestions only. AI Advisor never changes a process or its execution itself, and process owners decide what to implement.

"Our customers want to know where AI Agents will have a real, measurable impact on their business," said Gustavo Gomez, CEO of Bizagi. "AI Advisor shows the business impact first. Because Bizagi runs these processes, it can show each customer where AI makes the biggest difference today, the agentic redesign that would deliver it, and the evidence behind it, while their teams stay in charge of every decision."
